purpose: Explicit outcome-selected illustrative successes, not unbiased evaluation or a new test set
per_seed_success: GT deplaned p98>=2.5cm, >=80 relief cells (absGTdeplane>1.5cm), raw MAE and relief-shape MAE each improve >=10%, AFS amplitude gain>=0.35 and closer to1
ranking: First number of successful seeds, then minimum of mean raw/relief-shape percent improvement
metrics: Each map independently plane-fitted on identical original valid GT mask. Main absolute MAE unchanged.
